editorial:
Imagine the most powerful people on Earth getting completely lost in the middle of nowhere. That is exactly what happens here. You get to watch seven world leaders, who usually have everything handled, turn into panicking messes while stuck in the woods. They are supposed to be fixing a global crisis, but they cannot even figure out how to walk in a straight line. The vibe is weird and funny, blending a spooky atmosphere with a lot of shouting and arguing. It feels like a high-stakes camping trip gone wrong where the guests are the most annoying people you can imagine.

The acting is the best part because seeing these huge egos crumble is a blast. While the story moves a bit slow in the middle, the weird twists keep you interested. If you love dark humor and seeing rich people suffer, you will love this.
endingExplained: The movie ends with the leaders completely breaking down as they realize they are not actually in control of anything. After fighting and blaming each other for hours, they find out that the crisis they were trying to solve has already happened. The twist is that their arguing was a waste of time. They never actually find their way back to safety in a normal way, leaving you to wonder if they ever truly escaped the woods.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves political jokes and strange comedies.
